title: Coherated sheaf derived Hom adjunction for a qcqs pushforward
statement: Let X and Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, and let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image] have right adjoint a [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint], with counit (the sheafy trace) Rf_*a(K)\to K. For L\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) and K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y), composition with this counit induces a natural map in D(\mathcal O_Y), $$Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(L,a(K))\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(Rf_*L,K).$$ After applying the coherator DQ_Y:D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y), this map is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0A9Q (lemma-iso-on-RSheafHom), with Tag 0B6I (Lemma 48.1.1) for the trace map

proof.text: For L and K, apply the canonical internal-Hom comparison [lem-pc-sheaf-rhom-projection-formula] with M=a(K), then postcompose with the morphism induced by the counit Rf_*a(K)\to K. This is exactly the canonical map in the statement, and its construction is natural in L and K.

source.place: paragraph before Tag 0A9Q defining equation-sheafy-trace (first arrow: Cohomology, Remark remark-projection-formula-for-internal-hom; second arrow: the counit)

proof.text: Because DQ_Y is right adjoint to the inclusion of D_QCoh(O_Y), it suffices by [lem-pc-dq-coherator-adjunction] to test the displayed map after applying Hom from an arbitrary M\in D_QCoh(O_Y): the induced map must be a bijection Hom_Y(M,Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_X(L,a(K)))\to Hom_Y(M,R\mathcal Hom_Y(Rf_*L,K)).

source.place: Tag 0A9Q proof, paragraph beginning 'Since DQ_Y is the right adjoint'

proof.text: For such M, the required map is identified through the following natural chain of bijections. First, [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general] gives Hom_Y(M,Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_X(L,a(K))) = Hom_X(Lf^*M,R\mathcal Hom_X(L,a(K))). Next, [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] gives Hom_X(Lf^*M,R\mathcal Hom_X(L,a(K))) = Hom_X(Lf^*M\otimes^L L,a(K)). Since M\in D_QCoh(O_Y) and L\in D_QCoh(O_X), the object Lf^*M\otimes^L L lies in D_QCoh(O_X) by [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-qcoh], so the adjunction Rf_*\dashv a on D_QCoh from [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint] applies and gives Hom_X(Lf^*M\otimes^L L,a(K)) = Hom_Y(Rf_*(Lf^*M\otimes^L L),K). The projection formula [lem-pc-projection-formula], together with symmetry of derived tensor, gives Rf_*(Lf^*M\otimes^L L) = M\otimes^L Rf_*L. Finally [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] gives Hom_Y(M\otimes^L Rf_*L,K)=Hom_Y(M,R\mathcal Hom_Y(Rf_*L,K)).

source.place: Tag 0A9Q proof, displayed string of five Hom equalities

proof.text: The bijections in the chain are natural, and under them the map constructed in Step 1 is the identity on Hom_Y(M\otimes^L Rf_*L,K), by the triangle identities for Rf_*\dashv a, naturality of the internal-Hom bijections, and naturality of the projection-formula isomorphism. Yoneda therefore gives a bijection for every quasi-coherent M, so DQ_Y applied to the canonical map is an isomorphism.
